description:
Cast Oblivion Ring by paying {2}{W}.
Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, exiling Barren Glory.
Cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and causing you to discard your hand.
Oblivion Ring triggers, returning Barren Glory to the battlefield.
Proceed to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
